meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次深入调研变成带引用、经审核的完整报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 要做一次深入调研并产出可引用的结论报告
copy.tagline_en: Turn a deep investigation into a cited, reviewed report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a thorough investigation with a cited, verified deliverable

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 接到研究请求会先自己梳理范围、写下简报，再组建协作团队按轴分工检索、互相辩论质疑，用代码验证有争议的结论，最后交付每条论断都带引用或验证证据的报告（默认 PDF+DOCX）。
howto.when: 当你明确要求研究或深度调查，或提到 “ulw-research”、“ultradebate” 等关键词时触发；普通提问和调试会话不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深挖这个主题，团队分工检索
say.note: 它会先提格式方案，等你确认后再组队。

say.text: 对这个问题做 ultradebate 研究，争议结论用代码验证
say.note: 有争议的论断至少过一轮辩论。

say.text: 这次研究交付 PDF + DOCX，每条结论都带引用
say.note: PDF 与 DOCX 是默认交付格式。

howto.what_en: Claude scopes the topic and writes a brief itself, then creates a cooperating team that fans out across axes, cross-critiques via debate, proves contested claims with code, and delivers a report citing every claim (default PDF + DOCX).
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, or use "ulw-research", "ultradebate" and similar wording; ordinary questions and debugging sessions do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this topic with a team splitting the axes
say_en.note: It proposes formats and waits before building the team.

say_en.text: Do an ultradebate research pass; prove contested claims with code
say_en.note: Contested claims go through at least one debate round.

say_en.text: Deliver this research as PDF + DOCX with a citation on every claim
say_en.note: PDF and DOCX are the default delivery pair.
